verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs say Functions can be triggered by server events and scheduled executions, and can run event handlers and cron jobs, so event-driven automatic actions are a first-party capability. The evidence covers only short mentions, though, and the 'rules' are code you write rather than a declarative rule builder. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring event subscriptions/filters, a declarative no-code rule definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.
